title: Bind the packed Lean recipe to the exact P104 source graph
body:
**Independent source-binding audit:** the packed native recipe in [PR #7783](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7783) encodes the exact [PR #7761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7761) graph it names. Every recipe term, chart span, bank and field endpoint, and public output coefficient agrees. This checks the external graph-to-proof correspondence. **No new kappa**, Lean build or complete theorem admission is claimed.

Read the [correspondence proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e4a16a90fddd55d0389f79529958e6d1f8f84a56/research/p104-lean-graph-binding/PROOF.md), [exact certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e4a16a90fddd55d0389f79529958e6d1f8f84a56/research/p104-lean-graph-binding/RESULT.json), [independent decoder](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e4a16a90fddd55d0389f79529958e6d1f8f84a56/research/p104-lean-graph-binding/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e4a16a90fddd55d0389f79529958e6d1f8f84a56/research/p104-lean-graph-binding/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e4a16a90fddd55d0389f79529958e6d1f8f84a56/research/p104-lean-graph-binding/CREDITS.md). The formal source is `47ef383d7de8b77bd198b104c84efb06191a89c2`; the graph source is `d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07`.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Packed recipe | All 188,425 terms in 381 integers; all chunk lists and slots accounted for |
| Chart and owner data | 1,099 chart spans; both endpoints of 5,746 banks and 1,262 fields |
| Full graph reconstruction | Exact source digest `c6387f5a887f3ef2e79782cf2d7d167aeae5e6cd1e92d577e4c6e610ed360f84` |
| Public output matrix | All 1,592,644 rational coefficient positions match the packed diagonal/partner matrix |
| Negative controls | Eleven altered coefficient, index, chunk, chart and matrix cases rejected |

The checker reads the actual recipe chunk lists and decodes the deposited Lean integers directly. It does not run the packing generators. The bank-index map follows the source schedule and is recorded in full. Every bank reference is strictly earlier; every decoded index is within its formal bound. Induction on this common order identifies the formal linear recurrence with the source rows. A separate exact expansion checks the complete public matrix. The retained graph builder supplies the input graph; its output must match the published source hash.

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-lean-graph-binding
```

Both modes print this prefix and elapsed seconds:

```text
PASS_P104_LEAN_GRAPH_BINDING 188425 terms 1099 charts 11 controls
```

All 51 retained files are authenticated. Normal/optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. The retained builder runs in a normal Python subprocess in both modes; the independent binding checks run in each declared mode. The original CRLF notice stays byte-exact. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44462801889/job/135353377870) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

DreamingOfClouds (@DreamingOfClouds) supplied the formal package, [recipe](https://github.com/DreamingOfClouds/integer-mult-bounds/blob/47ef383d7de8b77bd198b104c84efb06191a89c2/research/p104-banked-banner/lean/Nov15/Bridge7761R4.lean), packed literals and [graph builder](https://github.com/DreamingOfClouds/integer-mult-bounds/blob/47ef383d7de8b77bd198b104c84efb06191a89c2/research/p104-banked-banner/lean/tools/bridgegen/apply.py). Clear1nsight (@Clear1nsight) supplied #7761's application and [graph receipt](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/evidence/application.json). Its graph and edits come from Ali Romman (@aliromman) in [PR #7756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7756), as its retained [credit record](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/pr7756/CREDITS.md) states. [PR #7777](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7777)'s [rational expander](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0288431ab2ad0cccfbede0b57cd3edfb2679e0f6/research/p104-first-relay-repair/verify.py) supplies generic coefficient and chart checks. All predecessor notices remain intact.

This is source-aware computational corroboration. No Lean build, axiom audit, complete proof-closure review, auxiliary proof-witness reconstruction, chain-certificate check, physical word, full caller, ordinary price, stock or compiler replay ran. The caller-list origin, `Valid` and physical realizability remain separate. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. All five inherited application assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0.
